content:
The [Cm to Feet and Inches Converter](/cm-to-feet-and-inches-converter) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Convert centimetres to feet and inches — for heights and measurements. Enter your centimetres and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

Convert a height or length in centimetres into feet and inches — the way heights are usually written in the US and UK. Enter the centimetres and the result shows the feet-and-inches figure (for example 180 cm is 5 ft 10.87 in), plus the total in inches and in decimal feet. It is the quick way to read a metric height in imperial terms, for people, furniture, doorways and anything else measured in centimetres.

## How to use the Cm to Feet and Inches Converter

Start by entering your centimetres. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. The steps below walk through each input in order.

1. Enter the length in centimetres.
2. Read the feet-and-inches result — the headline figure.
3. Check the total inches or decimal feet if you need the measurement in a single unit.

## Formula

Inches = centimetres ÷ 2.54. Feet = floor(inches ÷ 12); remaining inches = inches − feet × 12. One inch is exactly 2.54 cm.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Cm to Feet and Inches Converter](/cm-to-feet-and-inches-converter) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. 180 cm ÷ 2.54 = 70.87 inches, which is 5 feet and 10.87 inches. 170 cm is 5 ft 6.93 in, and 200 cm is 6 ft 6.74 in. Try the same figures in the [Cm to Feet and Inches Converter](/cm-to-feet-and-inches-converter) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Centimetres: 180), the [Cm to Feet and Inches Converter](/cm-to-feet-and-inches-converter) returns Feet and inches: 5 ft 10.87 in, Total inches: 70.87 in, Total feet (decimal): 5.9055 ft, Metres: 1.8 m. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. If you want to compare with a related calculation, the [Temperature Converter](/temperature-converter) is worth a look before you finish.

## Common heights in cm and feet

150 cm is 4 ft 11 in; 160 cm is 5 ft 3 in; 170 cm is 5 ft 7 in; 175 cm is 5 ft 9 in; 180 cm is 5 ft 11 in; 185 cm is 6 ft 1 in; 190 cm is 6 ft 3 in; and 200 cm is 6 ft 7 in. The average adult man is around 175 cm (5 ft 9 in) in the US, and the average adult woman around 162 cm (5 ft 4 in).

## Why 2.54?

An inch is defined as exactly 2.54 centimetres by international agreement, so the conversion is exact, not approximate. That is why dividing centimetres by 2.54 gives a precise inch figure, and why the feet-and-inches result is reliable to two decimal places.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Measure height without shoes, standing straight against a wall, for a true figure.
- Round the inches to the nearest whole number for everyday use — 10.87 in is usually written as 5 ft 11 in.
- For building work, keep the decimal inches — rounding early adds up across a room.

## Frequently asked questions

### How tall is 180 cm in feet and inches?

5 feet 10.87 inches — usually written as 5 ft 11 in. 180 ÷ 2.54 = 70.87 inches, and 70.87 inches is 5 feet (60 inches) plus 10.87 inches. Try it with your own numbers in the [Cm to Feet and Inches Converter](/cm-to-feet-and-inches-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### How do I convert cm to feet in my head?

Divide the centimetres by 30 to get approximate feet (180 ÷ 30 = 6 ft, close to the true 5 ft 11 in). For a better estimate, divide by 30.48. Try it with your own numbers in the [Cm to Feet and Inches Converter](/cm-to-feet-and-inches-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### Is 5 ft 11 in the same as 180 cm?

Very nearly — 5 ft 11 in is 180.34 cm, so 180 cm is just under 5 ft 11 in. Try it with your own numbers in the [Cm to Feet and Inches Converter](/cm-to-feet-and-inches-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### What formula does the Cm to Feet and Inches Converter use?

Inches = centimetres ÷ 2.54. Feet = floor(inches ÷ 12); remaining inches = inches − feet × 12. One inch is exactly 2.54 cm. You can see it in action in the [Cm to Feet and Inches Converter](/cm-to-feet-and-inches-converter) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.
